sloka: गच्छ त्वं वीर निर्याहि राक्षसैः परिवारितः ।जहि दाशरथिं रामं सुग्रीवं वानरैः सह ।। ६.५३.३ ।।।।
transliteration: gaccha tvaṁ vīra niryāhi rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ ।jahi dāśarathiṁ rāmaṁ sugrīvaṁ vānaraiḥ saha ।। 6.53.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Hero, proceed, accompanied by Rakshasa companions and kill Dasaratha's Rama and Sugriva along with Vanaras."
